baseline: Matched 1360x900 light/dark desktop captures copied from color-dialog-gpu-2026-10-23, source b2bc1b6.
changes: Hue/saturation and brightness gradients now use rounded textured rectangles. The hue marker is larger and clipped to its square. Brightness uses a neutral shell with a white center and an inset travel range that keeps the entire thumb inside its lane; pressing a displayed endpoint retains its value. Two per-context textures are bounded to 256x256 and 1x256 (257 KiB total RGBA payload); hue texture is reused and brightness updates reuse its existing handle.

gui.scope: Full UI suite passes. New light/HiDPI repeated-layout endpoint test checks displayed brightness thumb bounds, unchanged endpoint values when pressed, keyboard changes and cancellation preserving editor color/document/history. Existing RGB/HSL and pointer tests still pass.

classic_unit.scope: Includes a new gradient size/handle identity test, plus existing color conversion and UI geometry tests.

gpu.scope: Eight refreshed light/dark desktop/model-popup/compact captures. Pixel assertions check exposed dialog background at rounded corners and a red-dominant hue sample inside the gradient. The sample bounds account for existing linear-to-sRGB conversion.

checks: Formatting, whitespace and source file length checks passed.
limits: Numeric resting DragValue alignment remains centered because the existing public widget does not expose it. Full Windows/native color-editor parity, all color management semantics and the wider roadmap remain incomplete. Texture storage is bounded but this is not a rendering-performance claim.
